assessments.reasoning: The title leaf identifies the July 1995 NISTIR 5693 Volume 1. Printed A-3 visibly pairs the topic M (MUMPS) with the standard-column entry FIPS PUB 125 and lists test methods, service and certification or registered reports as categories.

challenge.method: Compare the printed table rather than OCR alone, especially its unhyphenated FIPS number, with the separately reacquired adoption notice of June 1993 and the exact ISO catalog routes. Distinguish the index of available testing services from a governing specification or any particular product validation.
challenge.results: The NIST topic wording directly supports this dated name pairing. FIPS PUB 125-1 explicitly adopted ANSI/MDC X11.1-1990 and superseded FIPS PUB 125. That does not alter the literal table entry or turn it into a substantive edition comparison. Exact direct ISO catalog access returned HTTP 403, and no ISO technical passage or equivalence was established.

limitations: The finding is the printed topic and standards designation in the July 1995 report. It does not identify the applicable ANSI or ISO text for any particular product.
